        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_100/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_100/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_100/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_100/test_9.csv"
    ]

    # Read all source CSV files into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        # index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column as per hint 24

        dfs.append(df)

    # All source tables have the same schema as the target:

    # So we can union (concatenate) all source tables directly.

    # Concatenate all source DataFrames (union)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
    combined_df = combined_df.astype({
        'admit': 'int64',
        'gre': 'int64',
        'gpa': 'float64',
        'prestige': 'int64'
    })

    # Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    combined_df.to_csv(
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_100/target_multisource_cot.csv",
        index=False
    )
